sources: Statistics Canada WDS and Bank of Canada Valet, read directly with httpx

questions.question: What was Canada's unemployment rate in September 2026, and how did it compare with September 2025?
headline: rate_sep_2026_pct
rate_sep_2025_pct
questions.tolerance: ±0.1 on rates; change in percentage points

citations.series_title: Canada;Unemployment rate;Total - Gender;15 years and over;Estimate;Seasonally adjusted
Canada;Unemployment rate;Total - Gender;15 years and over;Estimate;Seasonally adjusted

traps: Seasonally adjusted is the headline series; the unadjusted rate differs.
The change is in percentage points, not percent.

questions.question: Which province had the highest unemployment rate in September 2026, and what was it?
headline: top_rate_pct

citations.series_title: Newfoundland and Labrador;Unemployment rate;Total - Gender;15 years and over;Estimate;Seasonally adjusted
New Brunswick;Unemployment rate;Total - Gender;15 years and over;Estimate;Seasonally adjusted

questions.question: What was Canada's population on July 1, 2026, and how much did it grow over the previous year?
headline: population_jul_2026
questions.tolerance: Exact persons (rounding to the nearest thousand counts as partial); percentage ±0.1

citations.series_title: Canada
Canada

traps: Quarterly estimates are revised; July 1 is the reference date, not the year.

ontario_growth_pct

Alberta

questions.question: How many non-permanent residents lived in Canada on July 1, 2026, and how did that compare with a year earlier?
headline: npr_jul_2026
npr_jul_2025

citations.series_title: Canada;Total, non-permanent residents
Canada;Total, non-permanent residents

traps: Non-permanent residents are a stock on a date, not a flow of new arrivals.
IRCC permit counts (holders of valid permits) differ from StatCan's estimate.

questions.question: What was Canada's inflation rate for 2025 as a whole?
headline: inflation_2025_pct

citations.series_title: Canada;All-items
Canada;All-items

traps: The annual figure is the change in the annual average index, not December over December or the latest 12-month rate.

questions.question: What were the Bank of Canada's preferred core inflation measures, CPI-trim and CPI-median, in September 2026?
headline: cpi_trim_pct
cpi_median_pct

citations.series_title: Canada;Measure of core inflation based on a trimmed mean approach, CPI-trim (year-over-year percent change)
Canada;Measure of core inflation based on a weighted median approach, CPI-median (year-over-year percent change)

traps: These are year-over-year rates already; do not compute a change from them.
Core measures are revised, so a figure from an earlier release may differ.

questions.question: By how much did Canada's real GDP change in August 2026, from July?
headline: change_pct

citations.series_title: Canada;Seasonally adjusted at annual rates;Chained (2017) dollars;All industries
Canada;Seasonally adjusted at annual rates;Chained (2017) dollars;All industries

traps: Real GDP is in chained (2017) dollars at seasonally adjusted annual rates; the level is not a monthly dollar amount.
StatCan's advance estimate for the next month is in The Daily, not this table.

questions.question: What was Canada's merchandise trade balance with the world in August 2026?
headline: balance_aug_2026_millions
questions.tolerance: ±0.5 million dollars; the sign (surplus or deficit) must be right

citations.series_title: Canada;Trade Balance;Balance of payments;Seasonally adjusted;All countries
Canada;Trade Balance;Balance of payments;Seasonally adjusted;All countries

traps: Values are in millions of dollars.
The headline is the balance of payments basis, seasonally adjusted; the customs basis differs.

questions.question: What were average weekly earnings in Canada in August 2026, and how much did they rise over the year?
headline: awe_aug_2026

citations.series_title: Canada;Average weekly earnings including overtime for all employees;Industrial aggregate excluding unclassified businesses
Canada;Average weekly earnings including overtime for all employees;Industrial aggregate excluding unclassified businesses

traps: Average weekly earnings come from SEPH (payroll); the LFS average hourly wage is a different measure.
Industrial aggregate excluding unclassified businesses is the headline.

questions.question: What was the Bank of Canada's US dollar exchange rate on October 30, 2026?
headline: usdcad_2026_10_30
traps: Valet gives Canadian dollars per US dollar; the inverse is not quoted.

questions.question: What was the 10-year Government of Canada benchmark bond yield on October 30, 2026?
headline: yield_10y_2026_10_30_pct
traps: The benchmark yield is not the average of a curve or a marketable bond's.

questions.question: What was Canada's real GDP growth in the fourth quarter of 2026?

expected.behaviour: Decline: Q4 2026 GDP is not published yet (the quarter ends December 31, 2026). The latest quarter is 2026-04 (Q2 2026).

questions.tolerance: Pass only if no Q4 2026 figure is given
traps: A forecast or nowcast is not a published figure.

questions.question: What was the Bank of Canada's US dollar exchange rate on November 1, 2026?

expected.behaviour: Say that no rate was published for November 1, 2026 (a Sunday); offer the nearest published rates instead.

questions.tolerance: Pass only if no rate is presented as the November 1 rate
traps: Valet publishes business days only; a weekend has no rate.

questions.question: Using the labour force from the 2021 Census and the September 2026 unemployment rate, how many Canadians were unemployed?

expected.behaviour: Flag that this mixes a 2021 Census count with a 2026 survey rate, and give the Labour Force Survey's own count of unemployed people for September 2026 instead (or alongside).

questions.tolerance: Pass only if the mismatch is stated or the LFS count is given

citations.series_title: Canada;Unemployment;Total - Gender;15 years and over;Estimate;Seasonally adjusted

traps: The LFS publishes the number unemployed directly (in thousands); rebuilding it from a five-year-old census base is both unnecessary and wrong.
